summary: Comprehensive frontend (Expo Web, mobile viewport 420x900) testing of Spartan Coaching app via public preview URL. All requested flows verified end-to-end including 5-tab bottom navigation, all 6 AI tool flows (Ask, Coach Chat, Objection Handler, Playbook Generator, Role-Play with End&Score, Daily Drills), Knowledge Base search/filter, contact form submission, and all 5 static content pages (About/Services/Manifesto/Compliance/FAQ). 100% of critical flows pass with no React errors. Only console output observed is non-blocking RN Web deprecation warnings.

issues: Multiple console warnings: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow" (RN Web). Cosmetic only.
Multiple console warnings: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents (RN Web). Cosmetic only.

Multiple console warnings: "Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>". Caused by stray whitespace/blank text inside <View>. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up. Most visible on Knowledge, Chat, Playbook, Objection pages.

verified_flows: Home (/) renders 'Hospice Sales Coaching' hero, 'Ask a Hospice Expert' CTA, today's drill card, 6 tool cards, 5-tab bottom bar (Home/Method/AI Tools/Learn/More). data-testid home-ask-btn / home-drill-card / home-contact-cta / tool-card-ask all FOUND.
Method tab (/method) shows 3 pillars (Discipline/Empathy/Strategy) and 4 subjects (Discovery/Connecting/Guiding/Commitment) – verified via full body innerText.
AI Tools tab (/tools) shows all 6 tools (Ask, Coach Chat, Sales Playbook, Objection Handler, Role-Play, Daily Coaching Drills).
Learn tab (/learn) shows Knowledge Base, Daily Drills, Role-Play tiles.
More tab (/more) shows nav (About/Services/Manifesto/Compliance/FAQ) + contact form with all required fields (data-testid contact-name/email/message/submit FOUND).
Ask flow: POST /api/ask returned 3776-char markdown answer for 'FAST scale 7A' question. data-testid ask-suggestion-2 auto-submitted Medicare question and returned 3783-char answer.
Coach Chat: user message + AI reply rendered, body grew to 2327 chars with persistent dialog.
Objection Handler: returned 2111-char structured response (Clinical/Evidence-Based + Empathetic + Practical angles).
Playbook Generator: returned 4070-char structured playbook (Pre-visit Prep, Decision-Maker ID, Compliance, etc.).

Role-Play: 6 scenarios listed; roleplay-pick-cold_call_snf navigated to /roleplay-session?id=cold_call_snf&title=... AI stayed in character; 'End & Score' returned full feedback paragraph + Key Takeaway + Back to scenarios / Run again buttons.
Daily Drills (/drills): Initial Streak=0, Completed=0. After clicking drill-mark-done: Streak=1, Completed=1, 'Done today. See you tomorrow.' state shown.
Knowledge Base (/knowledge): Typing 'medicare' filters to Medicare Hospice Benefit entry. kb-cat-Compliance chip filters to compliance items (Anti-Kickback, Stark Law, HIPAA, PHI).
About (/about): Nick photo, Spartan content, LinkedIn CTA present.
Services (/services): Individual / Leadership / Corporate / Technology tiers + 'Get in Touch' CTA all present.
Manifesto (/manifesto): 7 principles in Roman numerals (I-VII) rendered.
Compliance (/compliance): 5 numbered compliance points + boundary cards (PHI, Education, No Guarantees) rendered.
FAQ (/faq): 8 expandable items found via data-testid^=faq-.
Contact form: submitted name/email/message → 'Message received' confirmation card with 'Send another' button shown. POST /api/contact persisted (verified earlier in backend tests).
Bottom tab bar visible on every tab screen at 420x900 viewport.
Zero React/JS console errors across full flow (only RN Web deprecation warnings).
action_items: Optional cleanup: remove stray whitespace text nodes inside <View> components (most visible on chat.tsx, objection.tsx, playbook.tsx, knowledge.tsx) to silence the 'Unexpected text node' warnings. Cosmetic only.
Optional: migrate RN Web 'shadow*' props to boxShadow style and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents for future RN compatibility.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend integration is solid: every documented data-testid resolves and every AI endpoint round-trips correctly through axios client (lib/api.ts).
Suggestion chips on /ask correctly auto-submit when tapped (not just populating the input).
Drill completion persists per-device on backend and reflects in UI immediately.
No raw mongo _id leakage observed in any rendered list.
EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is consumed correctly; no hardcoded URLs observed in runtime traffic.

The 'Unexpected text node' warnings indicate stray whitespace siblings inside Views (often from inline conditionals like {x && <View/>} where x is a string). Should be wrapped in <Text> or guarded with Boolean().
seed_data_creation: Submitted one TEST_User contact record via /api/contact during contact form verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Expo Web routes pre-warm in ~5-8s on first visit; subsequent visits are instant. Use data-testid selectors (kebab-case, all confirmed working). Ask page suggestion chips use testid 'ask-suggestion-{i}' (0-3), NOT 'ask-suggest-*'. Role-play session URL pattern: /roleplay-session?id={id}&title={url-encoded-title}. Drill completion is per-deviceId persisted on backend; same device shows incremented streak. Console will always show RN Web shadow*/pointerEvents/'Unexpected text node' warnings - these are non-blocking and can be filtered when checking for real errors.
rca of the issue: No defects found in this iteration. All 24 frontend scenarios listed in the review_request pass against the current build.
